items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdDlaIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c9aec1f797e8f637a46252ccaa3631e415914c78/newwcomer-month.jpg)

- - -
##### [HR]

Ovo natjecanje organizira Udruga Speedcubing Hrvatska.
Ako trebate dodatne informacije ili želite promijeniti svoju registraciju, molimo vas da pošaljete e-mail na **kontakt@speedcubinghrvatska.hr**

Ovo natjecanje sudjeluje u službenom WCA Mjesecu Novih Natjecatelja 2024. **Proces registracije osigurava 50% mjesta za nove natjecatelje.** Novi natjecatelji su oni natjecatelji koji još nemaju WCA ID ili imaju WCA ID iz 2024. godine. Natjecatelji koji imaju WCA ID od 2023. godine ili ranije smatraju se povratnicima. Svi natjecatelji i dalje moraju slijediti sve zahtjeve za prijavu kako bi se njihova prijava smatrala potpunom.

#### Prijave će se prihvačati na sljedeći način:
* 50% mjesta određenih limitom broja natjecatelja, osigurano je za nove natjecatelje.
* Na početku je za povratnike na raspolaganju 50% mjesta, određenih limitom broja natjecatelja. Prijave će se primati uobičajenim redoslijedom po principu "tko prvi , njegovo".
* Ako se više od 50% novih natjecatelja prijavi prije nego što se preostalih 50% mjesta popuni povratnicima, daljnje prijave se prihvaćaju uobičajenim redoslijedom za nove natjecatelje i povratnike u isto vrijeme.
* Ako mjesta osigurana za nove natjecatelje ne popune novi natjecatelji dva tjedna prije zatvaranja registracija, preostala mjesta, do ograničenja natjecatelja, bit će prihvaćena od registriranih povratnika.
 
Za više informacija, molimo provjerite kartice!

- - - 
##### [EN]

This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Croatia.
If you need any additional information, or if you would like to change your registration, please write an e-mail to the **kontakt@speedcubinghrvatska.hr**.

This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. **The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors.** New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

##### Registrations will be accepted based on the following:
* 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
* Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
* If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks before registration closes, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

For more information, please check the tabs!

items.name: Reno Blind & Side Spring 2024

venue.name: University of Nevada, Reno
venue.address: Ansari Business Bldg, 1664 N Virginia St, Reno, NV 89557
venue.details: Ansari Business Building, First Floor, Room 102

items.information:
### This competition will not have the typical events like a normal competition. Please see [Reno Spring 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RenoSpring2024) for information on a regular competition the day before.

* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.
* Competitors may only bring one guest maximum due to venue size constraints.

**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time. 
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

items.name: Northampton Newcomers D 2024
items.information:
**Northampton Newcomers 2024 is a series competition.  This competition (the D competition) will take place on Sunday afternoon.**

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorthamptonNewcomersD2024#38765-competitor-information) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years of age.

**This competition is a part of the WCA Newcomer Month initiative. Please refer to the [WCA Newcomer Month Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorthamptonNewcomersD2024#38849-wca-newcomer-month-information) tab for more information.**
